description: This header file declares the RemotePlugin class, which implements the Rust::IPlugin interface for the WPEFramework plugin system. It defines constructors, destructors, and various overrides for plugin lifecycle, initialization, deinitialization, messaging, and connection management, along with private methods and members related to remote process handling and socket communication.

classes.name: RemotePlugin
classes.description: A class implementing the Rust::IPlugin interface for remote plugin handling in WPEFramework, providing lifecycle management, remote process control, and communication capabilities.
